annotations.title: Look Up B2B Tax Invoice & Custody Certificate

description: Generate and retrieve a formal B2B commercial tax invoice (with Texas 80% SaaS tax exemption breakdown, Stripe tax code txcd_10103001, and buyer PO/company metadata) plus the cryptographic SHA-256 Chain-of-Custody & Zero-Retention Certificate for a job_id. Call this tool for enterprise accounting, corporate card expensing, or compliance auditing after job creation or payment. Requires job_id and accepts optional customer_email, po_number, and company_name. Returns JSON containing invoice_number, line_items, tax_summary, chain_of_custody_sha256, and deletion_receipt_sha256.

company_name.description: Optional legal entity or corporate buyer name to appear on the tax invoice and custody certificate. Example: 'Apex Robotics Inc.'.

customer_email.description: Billing or engineering email address associated with the order. Example: 'ap@robotics.io'.

job_id.description: Target compilation job identifier for invoice generation. Example: 'job_01'.

po_number.description: Optional corporate Purchase Order (PO) number to print on the B2B invoice header. Example: 'PO-2026-104'.

name: calligraphy_lookup_b2b_invoice
title: Look Up B2B Tax Invoice & Custody Certificate
